newsitem.title: USA: Goodyear "may or may not" buy back shares-CEO.
newsitem.headline: Goodyear "may or may not" buy back shares-CEO.

text.p: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co which earlier authorized a $600 milllion, three-year stock buyback program, "may or may not" repurchase shares, chairman and chief executive officer Samir Gibara said Wednesday.

"What this share buyback (authorization) does is ... give us the flexibility we need to fund acquisitions in an optimum way," or to offset dilutive impact on share earnings as stock options are exercised, he said in a news teleconference.
Goodyear was off 2 to 53-1/4 in late trading on the New York Stock Exchange but was near its 52-week high of 55-5/8 when the buyback authorization was announced earlier Wednesday.
